_comment: Plain-language wording for a validation finding, keyed <type>/<reason>.
DATA, not code, because two runtimes need the same words: js/engine.js says
them to a person filling in a form, and the scan report says them to whoever
cleans the data afterwards. PHP re-implementing the browser's strings is
NOTHING HOLDS THE TWO RUNTIMES TO THIS FILE YET. This comment used to say a
fixture, tests/messages_fixture.json, froze the rendering so CI failed when
they disagreed. No such fixture was ever written, and js/engine.js does not
read this file. tests/scan_report_php.php holds the PHP side to it. A parity
fixture is owed to wave 11, when the report first shows these words.
{placeholders} are substituted from the finding. A placeholder with no value
is dropped along with the sentence fragment around it, never printed raw.
'detail' is an optional second sentence for staff, filled from the RULE: the
keys a mode lists under scan.detailKeys in php/modes.json are copied into the
report's rule snapshot. A detail whose placeholders are not all set is left out.
'staff' is what a data manager reads. 'survey' is what a respondent reads:
shorter, no field names, no rule numbers. A report renders staff wording, but
shows the survey line too where it differs, because a designer needs to know
what the respondent actually saw and nothing else surfaces it.

required/required-blank.staff: This field must not be left blank.

unique/duplicate-value.staff: This value is already recorded on another record.

unique/duplicate.staff: This value is recorded more than once where this rule requires it to be unique.

choices/hidden-choice.staff: The saved answer is no longer one of the available choices for this field.
choices/hidden-choice.survey: The selected choice is no longer available.

window/window-early.staff: The date is earlier than its allowed window.

window/window-late.staff: The date is later than its allowed window.

window/future.staff: The date is in the future.
window/future.survey: This date cannot be in the future.

window/past.staff: The date is in the past.
window/past.survey: This date cannot be in the past.

window/*.staff: The date is outside its allowed window.
window/*.survey: This date is not allowed here.
window/*.asOf: Judged against {asOf}, when this value was saved.

exists/not-found.staff: The value is not saved where this rule looks for it.

exists/filtered.staff: The value is saved, but not in an entry that meets this rule's conditions.

exists/*.staff: The value is not saved where this rule looks for it.

range/soft-low.staff: The value is lower than usual for this field.
range/soft-low.survey: This value is lower than expected. Please check it.

range/soft-high.staff: The value is higher than usual for this field.
range/soft-high.survey: This value is higher than expected. Please check it.

range/hard-low.staff: The value is below the lowest plausible value for this field.

range/hard-high.staff: The value is above the highest plausible value for this field.

range/plausible-low.staff: The value is below the plausible range of its growth rule, which judged it because its z-score could not be worked out.

range/plausible-high.staff: The value is above the plausible range of its growth rule, which judged it because its z-score could not be worked out.

range/not-a-number.staff: The value is not a number.

range/*.staff: The value is outside its plausible range.
range/*.survey: This value is not allowed here.
range/*.zScore: Its z-score is {z} on the growth reference {reference}.

constraint/assert.staff: The value does not satisfy this rule's condition.
constraint/assert.survey: This entry is not valid together with the other answers.

single/format.staff: The value does not match the format this field requires.
single/format.survey: This entry is not in the expected format.

single/check-character.staff: The format is right but the check character does not match, so one character is mistyped.
single/check-character.survey: This ID looks mistyped - please check it.

single/too-long.staff: The value is longer than 512 characters, more than any ID field holds, so it was not checked.

pooled/no-id.staff: No recognisable ID could be found in this field.

pooled/check-character.staff: At least one ID in this field has a check character that does not match, so a character is mistyped.
pooled/check-character.survey: An ID here looks mistyped - please check it.

pooled/junk.staff: This field contains text that is not a recognisable ID.
pooled/junk.survey: Some of this entry is not a recognisable ID.

pooled/duplicate.staff: The same ID appears more than once in this field.
pooled/duplicate.survey: The same ID appears more than once.

pooled/count.staff: This field does not hold the expected number of IDs.
pooled/count.survey: This entry does not hold the expected number of IDs.

single/*.staff: This value failed the ID check configured for the field.

pooled/*.staff: One or more IDs in this field are not valid.
pooled/*.survey: One or more IDs here are not valid.

*/*.staff: Rule {rule} reported "{reason}" for this value. No wording is configured for this kind of finding.
